rSignificativity

rSignificativity is an R package that implements the σ\sigma-significativity for agreement values.

Help and support

Installation

In order to install the development version of rSignificativity, you need:

  • R and Rtools

  • the R package devtools

  • the GMP library

  • git

When the requirements have been satisfied, issue the R command:

pak::pak("albertocasagrande/rSignificativity")

Citation

If you use rSignificativity in your research, please cite:

A. Casagrande, F. Fabris, R. Girometti, and R. Pagliarini. Significativity Indices for Agreement Values. Statistics and Computing, 35(6):197, 2025. doi:10.1007/s11222-025-10728-1

A. Casagrande and R. Pagliarini. A Marginal Significativity Index for Agreement Values. In 2025 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM), pp. 5392–5399, 2025. doi:10.1109/BIBM66473.2025.11356859
